question: On a random sample of the products of one-bit decorations that escaped no listed crystal, does the forcing route start (parent labels forced, off-law parent collars removed by local consistency), or do off-law collars remain, and does a torus search from them find a crystal?

public_inputs.sample: 12 of the 3,241 surviving product classes of TWO-BIT-20261108-001A-E001 (its result.json), drawn by Python's random.sample with seed 1 from the sorted list.
public_inputs.parents: For each sampled product, the number of core collars of the level-one law in which the central tile's five children can carry a label vector that is no s(a), by SAT with labels as two-bit words (forcing4.parents_free).
public_inputs.level-one collars: Arc consistency on each factor's labelled level-one collars first (forcing_lib.Q_of, forcing4.arc_consistency); then the product's level-one collars from pairs of the two factors' survivors (forcing4.Q_product_from), kept when every child collar's labels lie in the product's law. Nothing arc-consistent is lost: the projections of the product's arc-consistent collars are arc-consistent for each factor.
public_inputs.arc consistency: The same support test as forcing4.arc_consistency (the first stage of ONE-BIT-20261108-001A's joint test), vectorized (forcing4.arc_consistency_np): each core collar's labellings as an array, the overlap labels encoded base 4, and support looked up among the alive codes of the neighbour's collar, repeated until nothing changes; used on the factors and on the product.
public_inputs.torus search: For the first three sampled products in sample order with off-law collars left, up to 20 of them as seeds (non-pinwheel collars first, then the others, each group in the order of random.Random(1).shuffle), by CRYSTAL-UP-20261108-001A-E002's search unchanged except at most 100 lattices per seed, with the arc-consistent collars as the law; a completed torus is a crystal when its cut admits a periodic two-bit labelling obeying the product's law on the torus's own lattice.
public_inputs.execution: Products one at a time in one process (the torus searches with 6 workers), under a systemd memory cap of 16 GB with no swap, so that the run can fail on its own but cannot exhaust the machine.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the sample, the tests, the seeds or the budgets after seeing results
primary_observable: For each sampled product: whether its parents are forced and how many off-law level-one collars survive arc consistency; for the searched ones, any crystal found.
secondary_observables: Law and level-one collar counts; torus outcomes.
cheapest_meaningful_control: The pre-freeze probe's survivor, 00001/00010 x 00111/10100 (if drawn, or otherwise run first as a control): arc consistency must leave exactly the 2,644 collars E001's probe found (964 in the law, 1,620 keys with other labels, 60 non-keys), since filtering by the factors' arc consistency first loses nothing. The torus search's control is CRYSTAL-UP-20261108-001A-E002's.
decision_or_followup_rule: The epic's frozen stop rule: the line pauses after this test, whatever it shows. A crystal found makes that product escape; a sampled product whose off-law collars all die would make the forcing route start for it and would be reported as the line's next candidate.
stop_rule: Stop at the declared sample, tests, seeds and budgets.
nonclaims: Exploratory and non-promotable: a sample of 12, local consistency only (not the joint radius-2 test), and torus searches bounded in seeds, lattices and steps.
Off-law collars surviving local consistency do not show that a product escapes; no crystal found does not show that it forces the pinwheel.
feasibility_disclosure: E001 (six products at once) was killed twice by the out-of-memory killer at about 59 GB; E002 (factor arc consistency first, one product at a time, capped at 16 GB) passed its control, reproducing E001's probe exactly (964 in the law, 1,620 keys with other labels, 60 non-keys, at a 1.45 GB peak), then reached the 16 GB cap on the first sampled product and was killed before writing its row. E003 changes only the arc-consistency implementation; its control is the same.
